newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Gui Zhou Tyre 1996 net triples.
newsitem.headline: China Gui Zhou Tyre 1996 net triples.

text.p: China's Gui Zhou Tyre Co Ltd posted net profits of 95 million yuan for 1996, almost triple 1995's 30.6 million yuan, on aggressive sales, a company statement said.

The company's turnover was 923.3 million yuan in 1996, up 35.3 percent from 682.6 million yuan the previous year, the company's annual report, published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times at the weekend, said.
The company's efforts to promote sales and increase production boosted earnings despite the sluggish market, it said, but gave no details.
Net earning per share was 0.8 yuan in 1996, double the 0.39 yuan of 1995, it said.

The company's shareholders would discuss at a forthcoming meeting its plan to make a seven-for-10 bonus issue and a three-for-10 rights issue tentatively priced at between seven and 10 yuan each, it said.
The company planned to use proceeds from the rights issue to upgrade production technology, it said.
Gui Zhou Tyre had 118.55 million outstanding shares at the end of 1996, consisting of 40 million A shares and 78.55 million state shares.
Its A shares ended the Monday morning session at 23.36 yuan on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, up 1.09 yuan.
